value.rationale: PASS: complete nonalgebraic one-types over named finite subalgebras are intrinsic invariants of a canonical homogeneous model. Deleting all 2^m algebraic types from a 3^m tensor feasibility matrix need not preserve rank or integral saturation. Here the entire nonalgebraic submatrix has primitive cokernel zero over Z, uniform full modular rank and exactly one more positive than negative eigenvalue at every size. This structural all-size arithmetic/spectral result, not a routine scalar count, is the mathematical contribution.
